rebuild_notes.status: Rebuilt as a multi-file SwiftUI app (Models / Store / Views / Support) preserving the OldOS iPod visual language.
architecture: OldMusicApp.swift (app + scene delegate, status bar driven hosting controller)
Store/MusicPlayer.swift (system music player, reactive state, queues)
Store/MusicNavigator.swift (screen, tab, per-tab push stacks, Cover Flow)
Views/MusicNowPlayingView.swift (artwork/reflection, flip track list, scrubber, controls, volume)
Support/OldOSKit.swift (verbatim from OldSafari), OldOSKit+Music.swift, OldMusicPalette.swift, OldMusicSlider.swift
removed_dependencies: SwiftUI-Introspect and the OldOS custom keyboard (the system keyboard is used and follows Dark Mode)
Fake in-app status bars, CoreTelephony and NWPathMonitor (the real status bar is shown over the extended bars)
fixes: Playback no longer requires an Apple Music subscription (SKCloudServiceController gate removed).
beginGeneratingPlaybackNotifications() was never called: UI did not follow the player.
Tapping a song queued only that song; whole lists are now queued from the tapped song.
Now Playing album tracks were sorted by title; now disc / track order.
removeDuplicates() dropped different tracks sharing a title; now unique by persistentID.
Album length used a single track's duration; now the real total.
Artists in search results were not tappable; Albums section added to results.
A–Z sections misfiled lowercase / accented / 'The …' names; MPMediaQuery sections are used.
SwiftUI state was mutated from background threads (timer, player callbacks).
Scrubber seeked from a background queue on every drag event; now one seek when released.
Volume used a throwaway MPVolumeView per change; now one hidden view in the window.
Repeat cycle and shuffle state were wrong with the player's .default modes.
Cover Flow could crash with an empty library or a nil current item view.
Referenced images 'CoverFlowPlayIndicator' / 'CoverFlowInfoIcon' did not exist; drawn natively.
MPMediaType.anyITunesU does not exist; iTunes U uses MPMediaType.audioITunesU.
features_added_beyond_original_extractio: Aspect UI in More (Sistema / Chiaro / Scuro), persisted, applied to the window
Dark skin identical to OldSafari Private Browsing palette (OldOSSafariTheme values)
OldOSKit.swift and the iOS 6 action sheet shared verbatim with OldSafari
Smart playlists: Recently Added, Recently Played, Top 25 Most Played
Long-press song action sheet: Play Next, Add to Up Next, Go to Album, Go to Artist, Share Song
Genius mix from the Now Playing atom button
Playback speed (1x/2x/0.5x) for podcasts, audiobooks, iTunes U
Lyrics over the Now Playing artwork
Shake to Shuffle with the OldOS iOS 6 switch
All Songs row for artists, remembered last tab, haptics
Full library browsing in More (albums, genres, composers, audiobooks, podcasts, iTunes U) and Videos
